_comment: An example custom glossary. You do not need one of these to use LoreLens —
it fetches from the wiki live. This is for novels whose wiki is thin, or
translations that use different names, or for sharing a spoiler-safe
Host it anywhere that serves it over https and paste the URL into LoreLens
settings under 'Custom glossary'. Fields not listed here are ignored.

entities.name: Gu Changge
entities._note_tags: kind 'fate' marks a tag that gives away whether someone is still alive. LoreLens hides those behind a tap by default — it is the single most useful thing this file can tell it. tone is one of: good, bad, accent, neutral.

sections.title: Who this is
sections.body: Heir to the Gu family and the antagonist the story follows. Ruthless, unhurried, and several steps ahead of everyone who has noticed him.
sections._note: alwaysSafe means this stays visible even with the spoiler guard on. Use it only for text that is safe at any point in the book.

sections.title: More
sections.body: In Chapter 900 he finally moves against the Immortal Court. Sentences that name a chapter are hidden automatically until the reader has got that far, so you can write freely here.

entities._note: firstSeen lets LoreLens say 'this character has not appeared yet' instead of showing anything at all.

sections.title: Who this is
sections.body: Entries do not have to be people. Places, techniques, sects, artefacts and cultivation ranks all work the same way.
